name: MonarchAiConversationList
title: AiConversationList
wrapsNative: List with a Section per recency group, searchable(text:prompt:), swipeActions(edge:allowsFullSwipe:content:), contextMenu, alert with a TextField for Rename, confirmationDialog for Delete
summary: The history of an AI chat: conversations grouped into Pinned, Today, Previous 7 days and Older, with search, the open conversation marked, and Rename, Pin and Delete on each row.
whenToUse: In the sidebar or history screen of an assistant, where people return to, rename, pin or delete earlier conversations.
whenNotToUse: For the messages of one conversation use MonarchAiConversation. For a plain list of items that are not conversations use a List with the system styles.
api: MonarchAiConversationList.init(_ conversations: [MonarchAiConversationSummary], activeID: String? = nil, isSearchable: Bool = true, visibleCount: Int = 200, now: Date? = nil, calendar: Calendar = .current, labels: MonarchAiConversationListLabels = MonarchAiConversationListLabels(), onSearch: (@MainActor (_ query: String) -> Void)? = nil, onNew: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, onRename: (@MainActor (_ id: String, _ title: String) -> Void)? = nil, onPin: (@MainActor (_ id: String, _ isPinned: Bool) -> Void)? = nil, onDelete: (@MainActor (_ id: String) -> Void)? = nil, onSelect: @escaping @MainActor (_ id: String) -> Void)
MonarchAiConversationSummary.init(id: String, title: String, updatedAt: Date, isPinned: Bool = false, preview: String? = nil)
MonarchAiConversationSummary.init(id: String, title: String, messages: [MonarchAiConversationMessage], isPinned: Bool = false)
enum MonarchAiConversationGroup: String { case pinned, today, previous7Days, older }

MonarchAiConversationListLabels.init(label: String? = nil, group: (@Sendable (_ group: MonarchAiConversationGroup) -> String)? = nil, untitled: String? = nil, newConversation: String? = nil, search: String? = nil, empty: String? = nil, noResults: (@Sendable (_ query: String) -> String)? = nil, results: (@Sendable (_ count: Int) -> String)? = nil, rename: String? = nil, pin: String? = nil, unpin: String? = nil, delete: String? = nil, renameTitle: String? = nil, renameField: String? = nil, save: String? = nil, cancel: String? = nil, deleteTitle: (@Sendable (_ title: String) -> String)? = nil, deleteMessage: String? = nil, deleteConfirm: String? = nil, showMore: (@Sendable (_ count: Int) -> String)? = nil)

options.name: conversations
options.description: The history, in any order. A summary can be made from the conversation's MonarchAiConversationMessage values.

options.name: activeID
options.description: The open conversation, marked with the selected trait, a marker and a bold title.

options.name: visibleCount
options.description: How many rows are shown at first, and how many Show more adds.

options.name: now
options.description: The reference time for the groups; the current time when nil.

options.name: calendar
options.description: The calendar and time zone that decide the day boundaries.

options.name: onSearch
options.description: Searches in the app; the list then shows conversations as given instead of filtering.

options.name: onNew
options.description: Adds a New conversation button at the top.

options.name: onRename
options.description: Adds Rename; receives the trimmed new title, never an empty or unchanged one.

options.name: onPin
options.description: Adds Pin or Unpin as a leading swipe and in the menu.

options.name: onDelete
options.description: Adds Delete as a trailing swipe and in the menu, after a confirmation.

states.name: grouped
states.description: Pinned, Today, Previous 7 days and Older sections; empty groups are left out.

states.name: active
states.description: The open row has a leading accent marker, a bold title and the selected trait.

states.name: empty
states.description: A first-run empty state: "No conversations yet".

states.name: no results
states.description: A filtered empty state with the query and a Clear filters button that clears the search.

states.name: long history
states.description: Only visibleCount rows, then a Show more button.

states.name: renaming
states.description: A dialog with the title in a text field, Save and Cancel.

states.name: deleting
states.description: A confirmation dialog with a destructive Delete conversation button and Cancel.

appearance: The system list with Monarch text: titles in default text, previews and group headings in muted text, the new conversation button in the link colour, the active marker in accent solid, the pin swipe in accent and the delete swipe in danger. The high-contrast themes resolve the same roles to stronger colours.
platformNotes: Rename uses a system alert with a text field instead of an inline field, and the web's arrow keys, F2 and Delete key are replaced by swipe actions and a context menu. Search is the system search field, so the list must sit in a NavigationStack or NavigationSplitView sidebar for the field to show. onDelete is synchronous; the web can keep its dialog open on a promise. Android uses the same names.
accessibility: The list is named "Conversation history"; group headings have the header trait.
Each row is a button read as its title and preview; the open conversation also has the selected trait.
The active row is marked by a leading marker and a bold title as well as the trait, not by colour alone.
Swipe actions and the context menu commands are offered to VoiceOver as actions on the row.
After a local search changes, the number of matching conversations is announced.
edgeCases: An empty or white-space title shows "New conversation".
Days are counted in the calendar's time zone; anything dated in the future is Today and seven days before today is still Previous 7 days.
A summary made from messages uses the last message's time and the text of the last message with text, on one line; with no messages it is dated distantPast.
Long titles wrap to two lines and previews to one.
